title: A repair that made the system smaller
promise: Follow the people and choices behind one practical repair.

beats.text: The dashboard said the repair worked, but users still could not complete the task.
A maintainer traced the mismatch to a state update that ran in the wrong order.
The team replaced the hidden coupling with one explicit transition.

asides.title: How the team tested it
asides.text: They replayed the failed sequence against the new transition.
